dataset_spec.name: cleveland_heart
dataset_spec.description: UCI Heart Disease processed Cleveland cohort (303 observations, 13 clinical predictors). Binary angiographic heart-disease status from the original num field.
dataset_spec.setting: Adult referred to the Cleveland Clinic (1980s) for evaluation of suspected coronary artery disease, who then underwent coronary angiography. The observations are the history, resting examination, resting ECG, exercise test and thallium scintigraphy findings available before angiography.
dataset_spec.observations_header: Clinical examination and non-invasive diagnostic findings:

text_values.1: ST-T wave abnormality (T-wave inversions and/or ST elevation or depression > 0.05 mV)
text_values.2: Probable or definite left ventricular hypertrophy by Estes' criteria

thalach.text_label: Maximum heart rate achieved during exercise

oldpeak.text_label: ST depression induced by exercise relative to rest

slope.text_label: Slope of the peak exercise ST segment

ca.text_label: Number of major vessels coloured by fluoroscopy
